Overview.Name: Sathwik
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), Mental wellbeing & stress reduction
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal

Breakfast: Option 3: Oats porridge (60 g) with milk (150 ml)
Lunch: Option 1: Brown rice (150 g) + chicken curry (120 g) + salad (50 g)
Option 2: Chapati (2) + dal (150 g) + vegetable curry (100 g)
Option 3: Millet khichdi (150 g) + mixed veg (100 g)
Dinner: Option 1: Grilled fish (120 g) + steamed veg (100 g)
Option 3: Paneer tikka (100 g) + salad (50 g)

Notes_and_Tips: Focus on portion control and consistent meal timings.
Use lean proteins and vegetables to keep satiety high.
Limit sugary drinks and processed snacks.
Include short walks after meals to aid digestion.
Prioritize sleep to support mental wellbeing.
